📦 **worktree `a754b6f`** — feat(world): detail Caribbean and surrounding full inland terrain

Cover the reference image land including Mexico and the southeastern US interior. Join haloed DEM blocks before simplifying contours; preserve authored harbour carves, reefs, fairways and remote source contours. Add reproducible inputs, dependency checks, preview and seam evidence.

Validation: original-source rebuild preserves all 412 old terrain files byte-for-byte; two independent expanded builds match all 637 file hashes; three tile roundtrip levels have zero errors. Topology has zero parent errors, equal-height overlaps or artificial boundary edges. All 252,738 seam samples agree across load orders; six groups of adjacent terrain chunks have zero shared Float32 height difference. Remote 200 height/material samples are unchanged, eight routes have zero land hits across 26,550 probes, and six town area checks pass. Synthetic corruption controls reject shifted blocks, broken shared heights, missing tiles, stale caches and overlapping contours.

Closed depressions retain the current exterior-ring format approximation. Harbour fixtures were corrected only after confirming the original points were land in both baseline and expanded worlds; evidence retains both point sets.
